To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of Mamdani's error-based fuzzy sliding model controller in highly nonlinear dynamic six-degree-of-freedom robot manipulator is improved by fuzzy-based tuning method.
the fuzzy sliding mode control methodology is an efficient and robust control technique for the highly nonlinear robot manipulator in presence of uncertainty.
the proposed fuzzy-based tuning gradient decent error-based fuzzy sliding controller is a robust controller in presence of uncertainties and it is a model free controller.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of a new controller for highly nonlinear uncertain dynamic systems.
design and analysis of chattering free Mamdan's fuzzy-based tuning optimal fuzzy sliding mode control method for highly nonlinear uncertain dynamical system.

the design and implementation of a new fuzzy-based tuning gradient-descent optimal error-based fuzzy-sliding mode control scheme for a highly nonlinear dynamic six degree-of-freedom robot manipulator, and it can be applied to other highly nonlinear uncertain systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed fuzzy sliding mode methodology is a powerful and effective tool to design a controller for highly nonlinear uncertain dynamical system.
the performance of fuzzy-based tuning gradient optimal fuzzy sliding mode control methodology is better than pure sliding mode controller in the presence of uncertainties.
the proposed fuzzy-based tuning gradient optimal error-based fuzzy controller has the ability to control nonlinear dynamic system in the presence of uncertainty.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed methodology is a novel design for highly nonlinear robot manipulator with uncertain dynamic parameters.
the proposed methodology can be applied in many applications such as; robot manipulator, aircraft, missile, spacecraft, marine, etc., where the nonlinear dynamic model is unknown.
the proposed controller can eliminate chattering and improve performance in presence of uncertain dynamic parameter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed controller can be applied to any nonlinear uncertain dynamic systems.
fuzzy-based tuning gradient decent optimal fuzzy sliding mode control is a promising method for highly nonlinear systems.

the fuzzy-based tuning gradient decent optimal error-based fuzzy controller can eliminate chattering, reduce overshoot, rise time, steady state and root-mean square errors and increase the robustness of the controller.
